tree_provenance.source_statement: Watts et al. use a pruned ddRADseq maximum-likelihood phylogeny of 187 Ruellia species from Manzitto-Tripp and Daniel 2023
tree_provenance.primary_phylogeny_method: ddRAD; RAxML maximum likelihood; 187 New World Ruellia species; Ruellia primuloides root

rejected_substitute.reason: The 2026 source explicitly states that its comparative phylogeny was pruned from the 2023 187-species ddRAD maximum-likelihood phylogeny. Filename/organism similarity to the 2021 chronogram does not establish identity.

why_raw_read_reconstruction_is_not_autho: The preregistered estimator uses patristic distances, so topology and branch lengths are part of the estimand input.
Reconstructing a new RAxML tree from the public raw reads would not prove identity to the exact timed/pruned tree consumed by the Watts et al. author code.

Tree reconstruction choices made after the programme exists could alter pairwise patristic distances; therefore a new reconstruction requires a separately frozen estimand rather than being treated as source recovery.
release_condition: Recover authoritative bytes for 03-Ruellia_phylo.timed.tre, an authoritative final 2023 ML tree object plus an outcome-independent deterministic pruning/timing recipe demonstrably matching the Watts tree, or an author-supplied exact tree/hash. Then freeze tree hash, branch lengths, phylo_ID crosswalk, and species representative rule before HPLC outcomes are opened.
